name: Poor People
overview: Scripture acknowledges the persistent presence of poor people within the land and commands believers to respond with open hands and hearts, showing mercy and compassion toward them. The Bible teaches that honoring God involves caring for the poor, as neglecting them is equated with sin and reproach against the Creator. Those who give generously to the poor are promised blessings and repayment from the Lord, emphasizing that acts of kindness toward the needy are viewed as lending to God Himself. Righteous individuals actively consider and defend the cause of the poor, contrasting with the wicked who ignore their plight.
